Augmented reality hologram game for iOS - Penguin Pat

Penguin Pat is my first game, and actually the first programming project I followed through to completion. I was inspired by Magic Leap to look into augmented reality technology. After some research, I found that it would be possible for me to create my augmented reality project. I learned how to use the Unity game engine, C#, and Blender, all on the fly while creating Penguin Pat. It's really cool to see the game rendered in 3D hologram on your coffee table as if it was a real life object!
